texte.C'est le règlement (UE) #/# qui tient ce: It is Regulation (EU) #/# that plays this role for the Union institutions, bodies, offices and agencies, under the supervision of the EDPS. Applying the GDPR out of habit means targeting the wrong text.
texte.C'est un PLAFOND. Un défaut qui arrête u: It is a CEILING. A defect that stops an auditor — an inadmissible Statement of Applicability, for example — does not erase the work done, but prevents going beyond it. No effort on the rest of the standard will cross this line while the blocker holds.
texte.CE QUE CES MODULES COUVRENT, ET CE QU’IL: WHAT THESE MODULES COVER, AND WHAT THEY DO NOT COVER: they deal with AI compliance and governance. They do not replace any technical operations training — electrical, cooling, low-voltage systems, security. Those skills are trained elsewhere, and that is precisely where the shortage is most acute in the profession.
texte.CE QUE SENTINEL NE PORTE PAS : les gabar: WHAT SENTINEL DOES NOT CARRY: the templates of Annexes V and VII of the CRA are not in the library. Linking them here would be a misleading reference.
texte.CE QUE SENTINEL NE PORTE PAS : votre tun: WHAT SENTINEL DOES NOT CARRY: your sales funnel, your accounts, your contracts. The platform produces the argument, the figure and the document; deal tracking stays in your client relationship management tool.
texte.CE QUE SENTINEL NE PORTE PAS ENCORE : le: WHAT SENTINEL DOES NOT YET CARRY: model quality indicators — precision, latency, hallucination rate for LLMs and RAG architectures, explainability, robustness. To be defined and measured outside the tool, and recorded as criteria for moving from PoC to MVP.
texte.CE QUE SENTINEL NE PORTE PAS ENCORE, et: WHAT SENTINEL DOES NOT YET CARRY, and which is conducted in a workshop: the architecture decision tree (foundation model, RAG, agentic system or classic predictive ML) and the estimate of infrastructure costs — compute and tokens.
